title: wavCSE primary-artifact acquisition attempt
description: One append-only provenance record of an attempt to admit a primary artifact. The artifact's identity and bytes live in primary_manifest.jsonl and the disposable cache; this row only records how the attempt arrived, what it resolved to, and how it ended. Paper identity and bibliography stay in catalog.jsonl. Schema v1 is the INC-011 (USER_SUPPLIED) shape; v2 adds the optional acquisition-channel fields below, written only for PUBLIC_ACQUIRED attempts. v1 rows remain valid and are never rewritten.

acquisition_id.description: deterministic identity of the attempt, derived from provenance, identity hints and the resolved artifact digest

provenance.description: the acquisition channel; more channels are added by later increments, never a new pipeline

paper_id.description: resolved canonical paper_id, or null when the attempt was rejected before a Paper was identified

role.description: artifact version/role the attempt addressed, or null when unresolved

sha256.description: exact-byte identity of the candidate artifact, or null when the bytes were unavailable

media_type.description: canonical media type when a PDF was validated, else null

source_url.description: the catalog source URL the artifact was associated with, or null

source_label.description: opaque provenance label (a basename or host, never a filesystem path)

failure_kind.description: deterministic failure taxonomy on rejection, else null

detail.description: machine-readable failure context; never credential material

retrieved_url.description: v2: the URL the bytes were actually retrieved from (https), or null; required for PUBLIC_ACQUIRED

discovery_provider.description: v2: the structured-discovery provider that reported the candidate location, or null

retrieved_at.description: v2: ISO 8601 time of retrieval, or null; required for PUBLIC_ACQUIRED

candidate_identifiers.description: v2: the strong scholarly identifiers the candidate carried (e.g. doi, arxiv, openreview)

identity_evidence.description: v2: the evidence that tied the retrieved bytes to the requested Paper
